fields.Name: T190 - AI Analytics Interaction
fields.Description: Opens the AI Analytics dashboard and attempts to interact with a date-range or filter control. Verifies the dashboard renders and responds to a control without crashing.

InputDefinition.goal: Use the application switcher to open the AI app, then the Analytics section. Verify the Analytics view renders — it should show analytics content (KPIs, charts, date-range/filter controls) OR a valid empty-state. If it shows a brief loading state, WAIT (10-30s) for it to render. Try interacting with a date-range or filter control if present. Success = the Analytics view renders its content or a valid empty-state without crashing. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI Analytics view was opened
The Analytics view rendered (KPIs/charts/controls or a valid empty-state) after waiting
No crash, raw error, or permanent blank/stuck screen
